responsibility: This file provides the host-side hook definition for building GCC itself on Darwin systems running on AArch64/arm64. It does not add AArch64-specific host behavior of its own; instead it instantiates the standard host_hooks object using the generic Darwin host support from config/host-darwin.h, serving as the architecture-and-host selection point that lets the compiler use the normal Darwin host services on an AArch64 host build.
